notes.title: Working on the game just ramped up!
notes.content:
Nick and I will be ramping up production to push the core game out by December 3rd!
Heres what to expect in the coming weeks:
*New weapons
*P6V, The snow world, and anti franks base will be finished levels
*new enemies
*At least one cutscene, potentially more.
*3 bosses (Robo-Goat, Jose, Anti Frank)
*new upgrades
*thoroughly decorated levels
*more music / sound effects!
*more stuff im probably missing such as quality of life, visual, and gui updates!

***Reminder: There will be free content updates after the game is launched.


Heres a sneak peak at some new content!
